title: AC1024 SORTENTSTABLE owner dictionary with associative-network sibling
mode: Primary-source research, local source audit, diagnostic-only existing AC1024 sample, bounded implementation, and focused fast-test verification
scope: Re-evaluate the SORTENTSTABLE extension-dictionary reciprocity failure after the Model LAYOUT 331/VPORT correction.
Determine whether ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK may legally coexist with ACAD_SORTENTS under a BLOCK_RECORD extension dictionary.
Broaden comparison against the current LibreCAD bundled inventory and LibreDWG source while separating inventory/stability labels from semantic qualification.
Refine PAR-06/7BV and PAR-49/7G.3 implementation readiness without promoting support or importing fixtures.

sources.name: Autodesk AssocNetwork.GetInstanceFromObject
sources.observed: The associative network is owned through a special subdictionary under the owning object's extension dictionary; the default dictionary key is ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK.
sources.limits: API ownership description; does not define the complete DXF group grammar or prove arbitrary network serialization semantics.

sources.name: Autodesk Networks of Actions developer guide
sources.observed: Describes a top-level network under the NOD through a subdictionary, and block-table-record-associated networks under their extension dictionaries through the same subdictionary pattern; network ownership and evaluation relationships can be logical and/or physical.
sources.limits: Establishes documented hierarchy patterns, not the target roles of every group in a specific AC1024 file.

sources.name: Autodesk SORTENTSTABLE DXF reference
sources.observed: The SORTENTSTABLE object is attached to a Model/Paper Space block extension dictionary under ACAD_SORTENTS and contains owner and entity-handle references.
sources.limits: Documents the SORTENTS branch; does not say the containing extension dictionary has no other entries.

sources.name: Autodesk DICTIONARY DXF reference
sources.observed: Dictionary entry keys are unique; group 280 controls whether entries are treated as hard-owned, and group 350 is a soft-owner reference to each entry object. Dictionary owner and persistent-reactor links are serialized separately.
sources.limits: Defines generic DICTIONARY representation, not the complete DXF field layout or graph semantics of every associative class.

sources.name: Autodesk pointer and ownership references
sources.observed: An object may have multiple pointer references but only one owner; ownership and pointer relations are distinct graph edges.
sources.limits: Generic object-reference semantics; does not enumerate every associative-network edge type.

sources.name: LibreCAD current bundled DWG/DXF coverage inventory
sources.observed: The inventory calls itself a deterministic source inventory rather than byte-level conformance. DXF-object ASSOCNETWORK is marked raw-preserved/read-write yes/yes/fixture-needed, while DWG custom-class ACDBASSOCNETWORK is typed-custom/read-write no/no/fixture-needed. The inventory summary reports zero validated fixed DWG object shells.
sources.limits: Mutable consumer-fork source inventory; raw-preserved and read/write flags do not constitute fixture-backed or semantic qualification, nor establish standalone-upstream behavior.

sources.name: LibreDWG current mutable object stability table
sources.observed: Current objects.in marks ASSOCNETWORK and ASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY STABLE, while the current manual still lists ASSOCNETWORK among unhandled/broken-or-undertested fields and NEWS retains an older/new unstable inventory.
sources.limits: Mutable branch with contradictory status artifacts. Pin a release/commit and inspect matching code/tests before comparator use; class stability is not semantic qualification.

sources.name: LibreDWG current NEWS and manual
sources.observed: The current manual classifies ASSOCNETWORK among fields that are specified but broken/undertested; NEWS also describes it in an unstable inventory, conflicting with the current objects.in STABLE label.
sources.limits: Source documentation/status artifacts are not fully synchronized; this mismatch is itself a reason not to promote support from the status table alone.

sources.name: Local source and generated tests
sources.observed: DWG SORTENTSTABLE uses a separate bounded typed membership receipt rather than the DXF raw companion. The validator accepts only ACAD_SORTENTS plus one ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK sibling, validates the nested dictionary identity/owner/reactor/single entry, then rejects explicitly because the DWG associative shell is not retained for DXF replay. Generated DXF-source and DWG-source graph tests exercise ASCII and Binary DXF output modes, sentinel preservation, and same-adapter corrected retry.
sources.limits: The generated route does not prove a complete associative nested graph or its serializer; ASCII/Binary modes are output modes on in-memory graph tests, not persistent ASCII/Binary fixture-file coverage.

sources.name: Diagnostic-only local AC1024 trace
sources.observed: After PAR-142, partial read reports 663 observed/published frames, zero entity/object parse failures, and 14 skipped ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY instances. SORTENTSTABLE handle 8336 has parent/extension dictionary 8331 and owner BLOCK_RECORD *U7 handle 8311; its reactor points to 8331. The complete owner dictionary has ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK -> 8332 and ACAD_SORTENTS -> 8336. Dictionary 8332 has parent 8331, one reactor to 8331, and one ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK entry -> 8333; the callback identifies handle 8333 as ACDBASSOCNETWORK owned by 8332. Export exits nonzero at SORTENTSTABLE ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK lacks safe DXF replay closure.
sources.limits: This is diagnostic-only on a pre-existing sample of unverified provenance. The trace does not establish all network/action/dependency edges, semantic safety of omission, or consumer acceptance. It is not a successful conversion or support claim. Output and log were written only under a disposable system temporary directory.

assessment.decision: Do not reject solely because the extension dictionary also contains ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK, but do not relax to permissive export until its nested graph is retained/remapped or safely atomically omitted under an explicit partial-output policy.

planChanges: Added a current research checkpoint that distinguishes documented ACAD_SORTENTS and ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK sibling branches from serializer readiness.
Refined existing PAR-06/7BV and PAR-49/7G.3; no duplicate finding or top-level subplan was added.
Specified bounded associative subdictionary identity/owner/reference closure and strict fail-before-publication behavior for unresolved leaves.

Defined an explicit policy choice between full branch retention/remapping and bounded atomic omission under partial output; atomic omission must also account for top-level-network references and remain semantically valid for evaluated 2D geometry.

Implemented narrow sibling-topology validation and explicit missing-DXF-replay-closure rejection; generated in-memory DXF-source/DWG-source graph tests exercise ASCII/Binary output modes, sentinel preservation, and same-adapter corrected retry.
Added DICTIONARY ownership/reference semantics to the research boundary and clarified that LibreCAD's DXF ASSOCNETWORK route and DWG ACDBASSOCNETWORK route have different inventory statuses.
Corrected peer-evidence interpretation: LibreDWG current objects.in and its manual/NEWS disagree on ASSOCNETWORK maturity; none of these mutable labels qualifies semantic support.

validation: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests dwg2dxf --parallel 2 passed with the repository's existing warning-as-error settings.
One diagnostic-only existing AC1024 conversion still exits nonzero at SORTENTSTABLE ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK lacks safe DXF replay closure; this confirms only the deliberate fail-closed boundary.
The source comparison used official Autodesk documentation and current primary repository files; no peer binary was run.

limitations: The AC1024 drawing remains partial-observed with 14 skipped associative dependency-body records; these findings cannot promote format support.
The nested ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK key target is identified as the ACDBASSOCNETWORK shell, but its action/dependency closure is not retained or semantically validated.
No complete associative DXF grammar, DWG byte-layout modification, graph remapping, or atomic omission implementation is established in this pass.
Current LibreCAD bundled inventory flags associative routes fixture-needed, and its fork is not an independent second parser for standalone libdxfrw.
LibreDWG's mutable objects.in stability labels conflict with broader NEWS/manual prose; exact revision and matching tests are required for any future peer comparison.
The broad shared worktree has overlapping uncommitted changes; no commit or staging was attempted.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
